title: REQ · Scene content declares dust, ambient light and a fade transition with validation
summary: sceneSchema accepts an optional validated effects list and bedroom.yaml declares effects
description: Context: sceneSchema has no effects field. Desired: effectSchema as a discriminated union of dust (asset, count, area), ambientLight (color, alpha) and transition (type fade, durationMs). Expected: bedroom.yaml carries them and loads without errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with valid dust, ambientLight and fade entries, when parseWorldContent('scene') runs, then ok is true
Given a fade with negative durationMs, when parsed, then errors include a path starting with effects.0
Given a scene without effects, when parsed, then it still validates
